summary: Verified Call-Status filter dropdown on /customers (backend + frontend). 11/11 backend pytest passed. Frontend UI verified end-to-end: dropdown placement, all 7 options, amber active styling, match-count badge, combinable filters, no_status branch, denormalised latest_call_status maintenance across POST/PATCH/DELETE/quick-status follow-up mutations.
critical_code_review_comments: customers/routes.py get_customers(): when call_status is set together with search/finance_bank (which already use $and/$or via _build_customer_query), the new ?call_status=no_status branch unconditionally assigns query['$or'] = [...] which can OVERWRITE a pre-existing top-level $or if any future filter introduces one at top level. Currently safe (existing $or lives inside $and), but worth wrapping the no_status condition into the and_clauses pattern for forward-safety.

CustomerFilters.jsx hard-codes CALL_STATUS_OPTIONS = ['Dialed','Connected','Unanswered','Follow-up','Completed'] — the same list also exists in the backend statuses payload and on the follow-up table. Consider sourcing from /api/customers/{id}/follow-ups statuses field or a shared constants module to avoid drift if a new status is ever added.
Badge pluralisation logic ('match' vs 'matches') is inline — fine for now, but if more match-count badges are added in the app, extract a small helper.

test_call_status_filter.py and several existing backend tests fall back to a hardcoded preview URL when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing — acceptable since runtime always sets it, but consider failing fast in tests to surface env misconfiguration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_call_status_filter.py covers 7 filter behaviours (no filter, Connected, Unanswered, Completed, no_status, total-vs-page, combined w/ agreement_filter) and 4 denormalisation sequences (add, patch, delete-all, quick-status). Reuses Ramya customer; restores her follow_ups via re-POST after the delete-all test. Frontend Playwright sequence verified: dropdown options list, amber border-amber-400+bg-amber-50 trigger styling on non-default value, badge data-testid='filter-call-status-count' with singular/plural copy, URL params via captured network requests (call_status=, no_status=, combined agreement_filter+call_status).
